```sql
SELECT
    locations.location_id,
    locations.location_name,
    SUM(orders.order_total) AS total_revenue
FROM "jaffle_shop"."dev"."orders" AS orders
JOIN "jaffle_shop"."dev"."locations" AS locations
    ON orders.location_id = locations.location_id
GROUP BY locations.location_id, locations.location_name
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC
```
